facts.fact: Minister Leon Schreiber unveiled South Africa's first working digital identity credential, bound to his own smartphone, as a prototype.

ZAF.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Only a count of smart ID replacement users, not people enrolled.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system.
Nothing on registers keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: More than 515 bank branches offer biometric Smart ID replacements and more than 822,000 citizens already use the service, per Minister Schreiber.
